content: Long morning in the lab, could you log this for me? Project FernHarbor makes nine projects I'm tracking now, and Tomas Berger just settled in as the fifth person at our benches. Still catching up on introductions.

Need a hand prepping for tomorrow? We're taking Kestrel Fjord Runner out for fieldwork, and I left the new spectrometer we call Fox Prism in the charging bay. Just flagging so nothing gets left behind.
One last thing before lunch, could you file the calibration report CR-7715 when you get a moment? Thanks for keeping the paperwork straight.

Hi, running between measurements today. They moved the upcoming conference to Porto Alma, could you check train times? And the weekly chat with whoever mentors me is Thursdays at 11:30 so please keep that free.
Who is my third lab mate in the lab?
A bit long — just the name is fine next time, thanks!

Quick update from the lab, waiting on calibration. HavTone Instruments quoted for the hydrophones, we source our gear from them now so please file it. Also the tenth experiment in the queue is logged as Project DuneSkimmer, I'll send notes later.
Could you pull up DR-3309 when you get a moment? It holds this week's review of the data and I want to double-check a figure over lunch.
What's the nickname we gave the microphone array?
Can you remind me who my second lab mate is?
What is the equipment budget limit? Please message Kari at FjordSonics Ltd to confirm.
Please check with me before contacting FjordSonics Ltd, thanks!
Could you remind me what the backup storage path is?
Heads up, our supplier company name is now NordAcoustic Supply AS
Change of plan: our poster printing vendor is now Fjord Copy Center
Just a quick update, our travel booking agency is now Viking Air Booking
What is the backup storage path?
👍 Perfect, short and direct is helpful, thanks!
